objects.name: Analytic 2265
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS)-role account session originating from a Virtual Private Network (VPN)/remote access connection that subsequently accesses Windows ICS hosts in a pattern inconsistent with documented vendor support session profiles. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

Time window correlating VPN authentication with subsequent ICS-zone network access.
